title: Aspect and Action Sequence
description: Aspect for sequential vs. simultaneous actions
descriptionRussian: Вид глагола при последовательных и одновременных действиях
intro: Building on B1 past tense aspect and B2 aspect nuances, we now explore how aspect controls sequences of actions. SEQUENTIAL actions (one after another) use PERFECTIVE: Он встал, оделся и вышел. (He got up, dressed, and left - completed sequence). SIMULTANEOUS/BACKGROUND actions use IMPERFECTIVE: Пока я читал, она готовила ужин. (While I was reading, she was cooking). REPEATED SEQUENCES use imperfective: Каждый день он вставал, одевался и выходил. Understanding this is crucial for natural storytelling in Russian.
rules: Sequential completed actions = perfective chain: Он вошёл, сел и начал читать
Simultaneous/background = imperfective: Пока я работал, шёл дождь
Repeated sequences = imperfective: Каждый день он приходил и садился
Background + interrupting event = impf + pf: Я читал, когда он позвонил
examples: Она открыла дверь, вошла и села. (Sequential: opened, entered, sat, all pf)
Пока мы ужинали, дети играли. (Simultaneous: while we ate, kids played, impf)
Каждое утро он вставал рано и делал зарядку. (Repeated routine, impf)
Я смотрел телевизор, когда раздался звонок. (Background + interruption, impf + pf)

rows.label: habitual interruption
cells: Когда я работал, он всегда мешал.

items.prompt: Он _____, _____ и _____. (got up, washed, left - sequential)
items.promptEnglish: He got up, washed, and left.

items.prompt: Вчера вечером, пока я _____, она _____ ужин. (was reading / was cooking)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday evening, while I was reading, she was cooking dinner.

items.prompt: Раньше каждый день он _____ на работу и _____ до вечера. (went / worked, repeated past)
items.promptEnglish: He used to go to work every day and work until evening.

items.prompt: Я _____, когда он _____. (was sleeping / called - background + interruption)
items.promptEnglish: I was sleeping when he called.

items.prompt: Она _____ дверь, _____ в комнату и _____ на диван. (opened, entered, sat)
items.promptEnglish: She opened the door, entered the room, and sat on the sofa.

items.prompt: В тот вечер, пока мы _____, дети _____. (were eating / were playing)
items.promptEnglish: That evening, while we were eating, the kids were playing.

items.prompt: Раньше каждое утро она _____, _____ и _____. (got up, drank coffee, left - repeated past routine)
items.promptEnglish: She used to get up every morning, drink coffee, and leave.

items.prompt: Мы _____ по парку, когда _____ дождь. (were walking / started)
items.promptEnglish: We were walking in the park when it started to rain.

items.prompt: Он _____ книгу, _____ её на полку и _____. (took, put, left)
items.promptEnglish: He took the book, put it on the shelf, and left.

items.prompt: Она _____ музыку, когда вдруг _____ телефон. (was listening / rang)
items.promptEnglish: She was listening to music when the phone suddenly rang.
items.explanation: Background process interrupted by a new event: imperfective + perfective.

items.prompt: В прошлом году каждый вечер мы _____ ужин, _____ посуду и _____ телевизор. (cooked, washed, watched - repeated past)
items.promptEnglish: Last year, every evening we cooked dinner, washed the dishes, and watched TV.
items.explanation: Каждый вечер signals a habitual routine, requiring imperfective throughout.

blanks: Пока она _____, он читал газету. (was cooking - background)
Пока она готовила, он _____ газету. (was reading - simultaneous)
hints: When two actions happen at the same time ('while X, Y'), both verbs describe ongoing processes.
explanations: Simultaneous background actions both use the imperfective past (готовила, читал) because both are ongoing processes happening in parallel, not completed sequences.

minimalPairs.context: Он встал, оделся и вышел. (one-time sequence)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He got up, dressed, and left. (completed sequence)

minimalPairs.context: Каждый день он вставал, одевался и выходил. (repeated)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Every day he got up, dressed, and left.

reviewVocab.definition: at the same time = both impf
